Thanks — I reviewed the register and pulled together proposed exec asks and the risk triage. Summary (for the one-pager):

Top 3 exec asks (proposed):
A. Temporary concession: Offer a one-time credit equal to 1 week of average usage if post-patch incidents continue into the renewal window. This buys goodwill while Eng finishes the patch. Rationale: avoids immediate churn risk and signals partnership.
B. Security/compliance note: Provide a high-level timeline (not detailed infra diagrams) for Private deployment readiness and a point of contact in our security team. Rishi to prepare a 1-page timeline.
C. SLA reprieve: Committed remediation SLA — we commit to a 72-hour priority fix response and daily status updates for the remediation period.

Risk triage (from the register):
- Latency/regression: High. Impact: customer satisfaction + potential revenue. Mitigation: hotfix in staging by 2026-08-10; controlled canary with Acme by 2026-08-17. Owner: Rishi.
- Procurement delay: Medium. Impact: schedule slip. Mitigation: Lauren to provide weekly procurement cadence until signed.
- Data residency question: Low (for now). Owner: Michael — track with legal and security.

Next steps: Rishi, can you confirm the hotfix ETA and list blockers? Lauren, confirm procurement milestones and date for signature. I will draft the exec one-pager and proposed credit language and circulate by Tue EOD.

—Michael
Director, Customer Success Operations
